title: EVIDENT: Routing MLLM Adaptation through Entity-Grounded Visual Evidence for Cross-Domain Video Temporal Grounding

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: Experiments on cross-domain VTG benchmarks show that EVIDENT consistently improves out-of-domain robustness while preserving competitive in-domain performance with modest parameter overhead.

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: To address this, we introduce EVIDENT, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework that anchors temporal grounding in the inherent entity-attention of pre-trained MLLMs by routing VTG adaptation through explicit visual entity evidence.

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: While the task has been studied extensively with specialist temporal localization models such as DETR-based architectures [22, 35, 29, 42], Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently emerged as a compelling alternative [15, 40, 11, 44, 33, 51].

methods.name: Multi-Modal Fusion and Feature Enhancement
methods.evidence_sentence: First, we propose an Entity Bottleneck Adapter (EB Adapter), which routes intermediate MLLM dense visual tokens through a compact set of entity slots to obtain domain-invariant representations.

methods.name: LLM Reasoning, Agentic Workflows, or RL Post-Training
methods.evidence_sentence: These findings point to a different design principle for cross-domain MLLM-based VTG: robust adaptation should anchor temporal localization in the inherent entity-attention of the pre-trained MLLM, rather than merely fitting dense visual tokens to source-domain scene context.

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
